name: Warren Buffett
blurb: Wonderful businesses at fair prices: durable moats, high returns on capital, held for decades.

name: Michael Burry
blurb: Concentrated, contrarian bets where the market has mispriced the risk.

name: Bill Ackman
blurb: A dozen or so simple, predictable, dominant franchises, held with conviction.

name: Seth Klarman
blurb: Margin of safety first: buy what is hated, hold cash when nothing is cheap.

name: Howard Marks
blurb: Risk control and market cycles over forecasts; know where you are in the pendulum.

name: Stanley Druckenmiller
blurb: Liquidity and earnings momentum; bet big when the setup is right, cut fast when it is not.

name: George Soros
blurb: Reflexivity: prices shape fundamentals. Position for the boom-bust turns.

name: Ray Dalio
blurb: Balanced across economic regimes; the equity book is a slice of a wider all-weather system.

name: Mohnish Pabrai
blurb: Heads I win, tails I don't lose much: few bets, low risk, high uncertainty.

name: Li Lu
blurb: Munger-style: a handful of exceptional businesses, held through the noise.

name: Dan Loeb
blurb: Catalyst-led ideas: restructurings, activism and dislocations.

name: David Einhorn
blurb: Deep fundamental work, long undervalued and short the overvalued.

name: Daily Journal (Munger legacy)
blurb: A tiny number of high-conviction positions in great businesses.
